title: Product definition, governance and decision baseline
goal: Freeze the product contract before software implementation: scope, user journeys, trust model, data policy, score definitions, MVP boundaries and decision records.

title: Repository, architecture and delivery foundation
goal: Create a portable monorepo, local development environment, CI checks, architecture boundaries, API conventions, migrations and durable project memory.

title: Design system, responsive shell and initial PWA shell
goal: Establish the visual language, accessible component library, navigation shell and installable PWA foundation.

title: Registration, authentication and account lifecycle
goal: Implement secure registration, sign-in, session management and account lifecycle using replaceable authentication adapters.

title: RBAC, Admin roles, SuperAdmin and tamper-evident audit
goal: Enforce least-privilege permissions, separate Admin workspaces, privileged SuperAdmin controls, guarded support impersonation and auditability.

title: Identity and constituency verification workflow
goal: Establish separate contact, identity and constituency-eligibility states while minimising and protecting personal data.

title: Geographic hierarchy, constituencies and election calendar
goal: Model state/district/local-body/ward/assembly/parliament constituencies and election events with effective dates and historical boundaries.

title: People, elected offices, candidacies, terms and party history
goal: Create a person-centred directory that distinguishes a person, candidacy, election result, elected term, office and party membership over time.

title: Admin CMS, source registry, media and publishing workflow
goal: Give authorised editors a safe CMS for creating and publishing sourced public records with editorial review and version history.

title: Promise tracker, milestones and responsibility attribution
goal: Represent exact public commitments, their original context, deadlines, measurable criteria, milestones and the authority actually responsible.

title: Evidence review, adjudication, corrections, reply and appeals
goal: Build a defensible editorial process for evidence, promise-status decisions, corrections and public right of reply.

title: Schemes, public projects and infrastructure tracking
goal: Track public schemes, projects, funding, agencies, milestones and documented involvement without misattributing outcomes.

title: Financial disclosures, assets, liabilities and business interests
goal: Publish dated, sourced public disclosures while avoiding unsupported claims of independently verified net worth.

title: Party affiliations, organisations, movements, protests and social accounts
goal: Represent time-bounded relationships and publicly documented activity without converting association into an allegation.

title: Citizen submissions, comments and community moderation
goal: Allow the public to submit information and discuss records with strong moderation, privacy and anti-abuse controls.

title: Verified citizen voting and privacy-preserving ballot service
goal: Collect one active eligible evaluation per verified person per promise while separating voter identity from public results.

title: Scoring engine, citizen assessment and leaderboards
goal: Calculate reproducible, explainable evidence-based and citizen-assessment measures, with fair cohort comparisons and no admin score override.

title: Public discovery, profile experience and side-by-side comparison
goal: Bring the data into a coherent discovery and profile experience that answers citizen questions quickly.

title: Gamification, achievements and civic contribution reputation
goal: Reward useful civic contributions without rewarding political opinions, volume spam or partisan activity.

title: Following, notification preferences and push/email notifications
goal: Let users follow representatives/promises and receive relevant, consent-based updates through replaceable delivery providers.

title: English, Hindi and Marathi localisation
goal: Support multilingual interface and sourced multilingual content without corrupting original statements.

title: Constituency maps and historical ward boundaries
goal: Visualise current and historical geography with clear effective dates and accessible non-map alternatives.

title: Official data ingestion, imports and reconciliation
goal: Import public data safely with provenance, repeatability, review and reconciliation; never silently scrape or overwrite authoritative records.

title: Transparency centre, methodology, funding disclosure, OpenAPI and open data
goal: Make platform methods, governance, funding and public datasets inspectable without exposing private or unsafe data.

title: Advanced PWA offline and low-bandwidth experience
goal: Improve resilience on unreliable networks while ensuring private, stale or action-critical data is never mishandled.

title: Admin analytics, anti-manipulation and election-period safeguards
goal: Provide operational insight and abuse detection while applying jurisdiction-aware controls for election-period risk.

title: Production hardening, security audit, performance and launch
goal: Prove that the product is safe, resilient, accessible, supportable and operationally ready for a controlled pilot.
